procedural_matters: FRA 8431 did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
facts: GER 8581 was running in to the finish line on starboard to leeward of a group of boats on starboard.
To windward of GER 8581 was AUT 7857 then DEN 8492.
FRA 8431 was on port with a collision course along side DEN 8492
FRA 8431 gybed on to port with her boom hitting the running rigging of DEN 8492
conclusions: FRA 8431 on port tack failed to keep clear of DEN 8492 on starboard tack, and broke RRS 10.
FRA 8431 did not avoid contact with DEN 8492 when it was reasonably possible, and broke RRS 14.

It was not reasonably possible for DEN 8492 the right-of-way boat to avoid casuing contact between DEN 8492 and FRA 8431 when it became clear that FRA 8431 was not keeping clear. DEN 8492 did not break RRS 14(b).
